tasks.title: Initialize Project Structure
tasks.description: Set up the basic project structure, including Vite, TypeScript, and necessary dependencies.

tasks.title: Create Canvas Renderer
tasks.description: Implement a basic canvas renderer with high-DPI scaling and glowing CRT wireframe aesthetics.

tasks.title: Implement Ship Physics
tasks.description: Develop the ship physics including inertia, rotation, thrust, boundary wrapping, and invulnerability.

tasks.title: Design Asteroid Shapes
tasks.description: Create vector-based shapes for asteroids with random jagged edges.

tasks.title: Implement Asteroid Spawning and Movement
tasks.description: Code the logic for spawning asteroids and their movement across the screen.

tasks.title: Implement Asteroid Splitting
tasks.description: Develop the functionality for asteroids to split into smaller asteroids upon collision.

tasks.title: Create Projectile System
tasks.description: Implement the logic for shooting projectiles and collision detection with asteroids.

tasks.title: Add Particle Effects
tasks.description: Create particle effects for explosions and other visual enhancements.

tasks.title: Develop Web Audio Synthesizer
tasks.description: Create a procedural synthesizer for sound effects like thrust, fire, and explosions.

tasks.title: Implement Touch Controls
tasks.description: Develop touch controls for mobile/iPhone and keyboard fallback for desktop.

tasks.title: Add Score and Lives System
tasks.description: Implement a system to track the player's score and lives.

tasks.title: Create Game Loop
tasks.description: Develop the main game loop to handle rendering, physics, and input processing.

tasks.title: Add Parallax Background
tasks.description: Implement a parallax background with a starfield effect.

tasks.title: Develop Unit Tests
tasks.description: Write unit tests for the core physics, collision detection, and scoring logic.

tasks.title: Optimize Performance
tasks.description: Profile and optimize the game for smooth 60 FPS performance.

tasks.title: Create PWA Manifest
tasks.description: Develop the `manifest.json` file for PWA functionality.

tasks.title: Implement Service Worker
tasks.description: Create a service worker to cache core assets for offline playability.

tasks.title: Add High Score Persistence
tasks.description: Implement local storage for high score and audio settings.

tasks.title: Test on iPhone
tasks.description: Thoroughly test the game on an iPhone to ensure compatibility and performance.

tasks.title: Test on Desktop Browsers
tasks.description: Test the game on various desktop browsers to ensure cross-browser compatibility.

tasks.title: Fix Bugs and Optimize
tasks.description: Fix any bugs found during testing and further optimize performance.

### Next Task Description

**Task:** Initialize Project Structure

**Description:**
Set up the basic project structure, including Vite, TypeScript, and necessary dependencies.

**Implementation Guidance:**
1. Create a new directory for your project.
2. Initialize a new Vite project using the command: `npm create vite@latest z-asteroids --template vanilla-ts`.
3. Install any additional dependencies required for the project, such as `@types/node` for TypeScript type definitions.
4. Create a `src` directory and add the necessary TypeScript files, such as `main.ts` and `types.ts`.
5. Configure the `tsconfig.json` file to ensure TypeScript is set up correctly.
6. Set up the basic HTML structure in the `index.html` file, including a canvas element for rendering.

**Testing Steps:**
1. Run the project using the command: `npm run dev`.
2. Ensure that the Vite development server starts successfully and that the basic HTML structure is displayed.
3. Verify that the TypeScript files are being compiled and transpiled correctly.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- The project structure is initialized with Vite, TypeScript, and necessary dependencies.
- The `src` directory contains the basic TypeScript files.
- The `tsconfig.json` file is configured correctly.
- The `index.html` file includes a canvas element for rendering.
- The project runs successfully using the Vite development server.
